metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code skills and agents for web / UI / UX / scrollytelling work, distilled from a multi-agent design bake-off.

plugins.name: model-render
plugins.description: Render a product's STL parts into polished high-res PNG product shots via an isolated headless chromium (assembled/exploded, per-part colors, camera presets, studio/dark/transparent backdrops).

plugins.name: ui-coaches
plugins.description: Four read-only advisor agents — storytelling, design, copy, and accessibility — that critique a page you point them at. Advice only; they never edit files.

plugins.name: web-skill-backlog
plugins.description: Seven documented, not-yet-implemented skill specs for verification-shaped web/UI tooling (mobile-reach audit, state-consistency, SVG/diagram gen, honest-dataviz, type-scale linter, a11y audit, email-survival bundler).
